contexts.text: Whatever there is of what is arcane in the ether and its modifications is stored away in the eye. AC 4523.
The fallacy that the soul is something ethereal. AC 5222. AC 6400:3. HH 74. HH 77. HH 170. HH 183. SE 3954.
The eye is formed to the whole nature of the ether and of light.
The interior viscera... are held together in connection and form by a more subtle air, which is called the ether.
Like animals in the receiver of an air-pump, in ether... DLW 183:end.
See Atmosphere. DLW 176. DLW 184:3. DLW 192. SE 418. SE 1176. SE 1830. SE 4063. AE 342:10. AE 538. AE 594. AE 726:3. AE 832:7. AE 1208:5. DWis 12. 5. 2. LJPost 320. Coro 17:2.
Not the least thing in the ether and the air that has not in it these degrees; and as the ether and the air are the receptacles of heat and light...
The forms of the members, organs, and viscera... are fixed by such substances and matters as there are in earths; and from earths in the air and the ether...
It would rise (above the air) far into the ether.
Like the state of birds in the ether. TCR 339. SE 3466.
An elevation as... from the upper air into the ether.
As the ether is in the land and water, by means of which the terraqueous globe is held together and made to revolve.
No quality of the air can be elevated to any quality of the ether; nor any of this to any quality of the aura.
They concluded that the human soul is nothing but ether; and that thought is nothing but a modification of ether... TCR 178:2.
From this it would follow... that the ether is the supreme God...
As the light of the sun, passing through the ethers, and, progressively, the air...
(Metals, stones, and grains of sand) freely absorb the ether...
The idea of God as of ether.
As the air... is to the ether or purer atmosphere, which belongs to sight.
Like the ethereal atmosphere, which reflects all objects... to the eye; and, in fact, to a thousand eyes at the same time.
As the leasts of the ether gravitate to the leasts of our body, towards the centre...
The skies (that is, the higher clouds) gave a voice () = truths from the spiritual sense of the Word.

As the Divine truth is the light of Heaven, it is said, Thy Truth is even unto the ethers (). By the ethers, therefore, in the plural, is signified the Divine light up to the highest Heaven... The like is signified by ethers in ; .
The skies gave a voice = influx from the Heavens.

As they live thus, they live in a heavenly aura, or in a heavenly ether; into which no one can be admitted who is not in life from the Lord: if anyone else should enter into that ether, it would be like mice introduced into an exhausted receiver.
It is transfluent like the ether.
Discrete degrees are circumstanced... as are the ether and the air.
